engine_identity: VEYLQUORIN (VQ); VEILFORGE is a historical compatibility name
purpose: One portable, offline-first model-construction knowledge base with downstream games and emulator QA kept separate

human_cleanroom.state: reviewed separately; preserve; do not rebuild over original

universal_language.name: VQShape/1
universal_language.state: reported working in separate Generate Human chat, not yet verified imported into these GitHub mains
universal_language.description: semantic grammar independent of individual object types

offline_grammar.state: isolated feature implementation; do not downgrade or replace with template

offline_game_runtime.state: isolated Android runtime testbed; no claims of validated animation support

human_anatomy_m37.state: preserve reviewed modeling improvements and QA evidence; never overwrite originals

always_persist: reusable techniques with actual QA outcomes
rigging, UV, material and shape-edit rules
triangle budgets, integrity checks, deterministic model fingerprints
never_assume: a GLB binary is needed to remember how to make it
a green compilation means visual approval
a grayscale provisional model is user-approved
a new generic template replaces an earlier verified technique
construction_knowledge.default_method: Build from abstract semantics -> controlled geometry/rig -> gray sculpt and smooth before adding triangles -> UV/material/animation -> real geometry or emulator QA -> learn reconstruction recipe -> user review

temporary: debug APKs unless user requests one
emulator intermediate logs, frames and build products
protected: semantic language, procedural scripts and recipe records
manually requested delivery APKs and recovery backups
retention.model_promotion: explicit human/artist validation with hash, provenance and reconstruction recipe before permanent archival
retention.cleanup_scope: Only completed GitHub Actions temporary artifacts, never repository source or user-device files
retention.cleanup_policy: daily name-allowlist, protect two newest and newest successful, exclude artifacts younger than 24 hours and approved/release names; no uncontrolled deletion
retention.requested_apk_artifacts: manual opt-in; short retention; user may designate a permanent approved release
retention.source_history: never rewrite/delete history to free GitHub Actions storage
retention.emulator_jobs: no frequent unbounded emulator matrices, one vetted pilot per milestone by default

architecture.network_assumption: no internet required by installed game and local construction engine
architecture.cross_repo_exchange: versioned shape recipe + semantic schema version + digests + bounded local GLB/OBJ candidate, with no remote service requirement
architecture.independence: Project-hail, ECHOFORM and Trion remain downstream independent; do not auto-mutate one from another

repo_roles.Project-hail: legacy game, human/creature model QA and compatibility
repo_roles.Trion-Assistant-Lab: offline assistant and paired app client
repo_roles.Engine-build: portable VQ core, model learning and experimental emulator runtime
